prompt:
SOURCE OF TRUTH
Use the submitted five-second reference video as the sole temporal camera and architectural geometry controller. Preserve its one fixed Apartment 106 master-suite shell, the accepted Bedroom 1 starting pose, the west Bedroom-to-WIR opening, the compact WIR connector, the only WIR-to-Ensuite doorway, every physical threshold, the camera height, rectilinear lens and exact endpoint. Produce one uninterrupted physically continuous take.

CAMERA PATH AND TIMING
0.00–0.60 seconds: begin at the accepted Bedroom 1 endpoint, facing the east terrace glazing with the same bed visible. Make one brisk continuous leftward reorientation across the same room; the bed must remain a persistent landmark during the turn.
0.60–1.70 seconds: move diagonally across the same Bedroom 1 toward the already-existing west/left WIR opening. The bed, floor and walls must move with true translation and parallax.
1.70–2.75 seconds: pass physically between the fixed Bedroom-to-WIR jambs and travel briskly through the narrow WIR. Wardrobe banks stay on both sides; do not widen the WIR or replace it with a corridor.
2.75–3.55 seconds: pass physically through the only fixed WIR-to-Ensuite doorway. Both jambs must enlarge and move behind the camera; never cross a wall or wardrobe.
3.55–4.45 seconds: continue into the same Ensuite and open the view toward the north fixture run. Preserve the plan-relative order: shower at the west/left end, toilet in the middle and double vanity at the east/right end.
4.45–5.00 seconds: settle into a stable buyer-facing Ensuite view with shower, toilet and double vanity readable, while retaining the WIR doorway edge at frame right as a continuity cue.

IMMUTABLE GEOMETRY
Bedroom 1 remains east/right of WIR. WIR remains the only connector. Ensuite remains west/left of WIR. Keep exactly one Bedroom-to-WIR opening and one WIR-to-Ensuite doorway. Keep the Bedroom 1 bed head against the north wall, terrace glazing on the east wall, compact room proportions, narrow WIR and compact Ensuite. Keep all walls, openings, wardrobes, fixtures, floor levels and ceiling height fixed for all five seconds.

ALLOWED VISUAL TRANSFORMATION
Replace only the simplified blockout surfaces with highly photorealistic premium Brisbane apartment finishes consistent with Koya's restrained official interior language: warm off-white walls, warm natural oak flooring in Bedroom 1 and WIR, pale timber wardrobe joinery, neutral upholstered bed and soft linen, slim dark terrace frames, light stone-look porcelain floor and wall finishes in the Ensuite, clear shower glazing, refined brushed metal fittings, realistic double vanity, mirrors and sanitary fixtures. Use neutral bright Brisbane daytime with soft directional daylight, physically credible shadows, natural exposure and subtle handheld walking micro-motion. The result must resemble real residential cinematography, not a game render or glossy CGI showroom.

AUDIO
Generate continuous understated natural interior audio: soft first-person footsteps aligned to travel, subtle bedroom/WIR/Ensuite room tone and faint daytime ambience. No speech, narration, music, dramatic effects or audible edit.

FORBIDDEN EVENTS
Zero cuts, dissolves, crossfades, morphs, teleports, scene replacements, static-image push-ins, duplicated rooms, wall penetration, door wipes, alternate camera angles, extra doors, direct Bedroom-to-Ensuite shortcut, missing WIR, widened corridor, moving wardrobes, moving fixtures, relocated bed, altered terrace glazing, fisheye, ultra-wide distortion, day/night change, flicker or exposure jump. Do not add a person, hands, operator reflection, text, logo or watermark.

ENDPOINT CONTRACT
The final camera is physically inside the same Ensuite near its south side, facing the complete north fixture run. The shower remains left/west, toilet remains central and double vanity remains right/east. The same WIR doorway edge remains visible at frame right. Motion eases into a stable useful sales view without snapping back or ending on black.
